text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a holding solely because it is down; I need a clear, forward-looking reason to exit rather than anchoring on my cost or reacting to losses.","I should size purchases carefully and keep enough cash to preserve flexibility, especially when adding to positions after recent price moves.","A few months of gains or losses do not establish that my approach is working; I should judge decisions over time against the market and follow a consistent plan."]}
